name: std::chrono::day::operator++, std::chrono::day::operator--
intro:
Adds or subtracts 1 from the day value.

1,2) Performs *this += std::chrono::days{1};.

3,4) Performs *this -= std::chrono::days{1};.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text:
1,3) A reference to this day after modification.

2,4) A copy of the day made before modification.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: If the result would be outside the range [0, 255], the actual stored value is unspecified.

summary: Adds or subtracts 1 from the day value.
